title: Workspace Interaction Shortcuts
notes: Adds a MITHRIL right-click menu on Drill Log and Shot Diagram canvases while preserving normal browser copy and paste inside text fields.
Provides Edit Hole, Copy Hole, Paste Here, Edit Holes, document info, Page Tools, and Cloud Sync actions based on where the user right-clicks.
Adds a Sync shortcut to the workspace header without changing cloud revision or conflict behavior.
Makes any clicked sheet active, even when the click is outside the hole grid.
Opens Shot Info when the date, Shot ID, job, or blaster area is clicked.
Preserves all m40.9.0 landing and cloud presentation changes.
